Simeon in the Temple, Luke 2. A just man was waiting, led by the Spirit, and he took the baby Jesus in his arms, blessing God, now lettest thou thy servant depart in peace, according to thy word, for mine eyes have seen thy salvation. Long waiting does not make God unfaithful. If you are waiting for a promise, keep praying, keep listening, you may hold His answer in a form smaller than a parade, and still the biggest news in the world.
